description: Extract the structured data a page already declares — JSON-LD (schema.org), OpenGraph cards, and meta tags — plus the AIO trust score. Deterministic, no AI: returns only data present in the page. Use for fast, reliable facts (prices, products, articles) when the site publishes structured data.

fresh.description: If true, bypass cache and fetch fresh content. Default false.

url.description: The URL to extract structured data from.

name: extract_data
